load_growth_invalid.why: update_solver_config (PUT /api/simulation/solver_config) or a network time-axis change refused the load growth: a rate that is not a finite number or is at or below -100 % per year, no year growth starts from, or that year after the first investment period. The message names the carrier or the setting to change; nothing was stored. There is no conversation-wide recovery action.

load_growth_factor_invalid.why: update_solver_config (PUT /api/simulation/solver_config) or a network time-axis change refused a load growth rate whose derived load multiplier for a period is not a finite number above 0 (a very large rise or a fall near -100 % over many years). The message names the carrier, the period and the multiplier; nothing was stored. The assistant asks for a smaller rate.
